title: MS Power BI Developer/ Reporting Analyst
text: MS Power BI Developer/ Reporting Analyst at Exclaim IT (Brisbane, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). About the Client: Our client is Australia's one of largest rail freight operator and a top 50 ASX company. Each year, the Company transports more than 250 million tonnes of Australian commodities, connecting miners, primary producers, and industry with international and domestic markets. It provides customers with integrated freight and logistics solutions across an extensive national rail and road network, traversing Australia. About the Role: Create regular and ad hoc reporting solutions such as dashboards, scorecards and other reports as directed Undertake analysis of systems, business processes, data and interfaces to tackle business problems Lead all aspects of assigned reporting including report setup, scheduling, standardisation, and modification of reporting solutions using Microsoft PowerBI based on data that is largely sourced from SAP/ SAP BW. Working with the internal team to upskill and share knowledge of PowerBI development best practice and tips and tricks. Design and develop intuitive and visually appealing reports according to standards. Required skills and experiences: Minimum 5 years experience in a similar role in a large and complex information technology organisation operating in asset intensive (preferably Rail, Mining, Utilities and Transportation). Demonstrable skills in similar roles with responsibility for the full software development lifecycle environment participating in requirements gathering/ scoping, design, development , testing deployment and maintenance with PowerBI and SAP BW. Lead all aspects of assigned reporting including report setup, scheduling, documentation, changes and modifications of reports in Microsoft Power BI Proficient understanding of Business Intelligence solutions: operational and analytical with a particular focus on SAP data. Undertake analysis of systems, business processes, data and interfaces to tackle business problems Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills. Self-motivated, proactive, detail-oriented, and can work independently as well as in a team environment. Experience leading meetings, and the creation of presentations, status reports, specifications document, and technical design documents. Previous experience on asset intensive (mining, utilities, transportation) would be highly regarded. To be considered for this role, please apply with a Microsoft Word version of your Resume.
